Served index.html contains NO inline <script> with window.location.replace (regex-checked on rendered document.content()).
Client-side navigation to /hizmetler, /projeler, /iletisim, /dr-ai-ile-uret works; each renders unique H1 with no reload loop.

src/components/SEO.jsx canonical link to https://www.dijitalroket.com is fine (SEO hint, not a redirect) — no action needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Redirect-loop fix verified on preview host. Note: the actual loop can only reproduce on the real production hostname dijitalroket.com (behind Cloudflare); preview host cannot reproduce it. Regression on preview is clean.
